characters.name: Nib
characters.design: Irregular indigo ink silhouette, round body, two large ivory oval eyes and black pupils, tiny ivory mouth, dark blue bent arms and legs. No rectangular robot head.
characters.proportions: Body radius 130; eye centers at +/-42, eye radius 29×39; eyes and limbs keep these relative proportions across scenes.

worldRule: Drawings can act. The notebook itself can be torn and folded into useful objects.
continuity: Nib escapes a drawn trap by tearing the page and making wings. Related episodes retain its design, not the same escape plot.
